concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-standard-integration-drop-in-customize-checkout]] — 2026-09-15 Standard Web Drop-in customization guide for dynamic/manual payment-method ordering, locale and translation fallbacks, separate RTL direction and CSS outside iframes; custom-locale example has a variable-name mismatch.
warnings: Manual payment-method configuration disables dynamic ordering (raw lines 26–28); do not imply both operate simultaneously.
Custom-locale example defines globalConfiguration but invokes AdyenCheckout(configuration) (raw lines 147–155); do not present it as copy-ready.
The child page has no explicit SDK version; do not infer a version from URL or treat UI settings as live availability proof.
